name: Viking Press
instructions: Stand in the Viking press machine, gripping the handles at shoulder height.
Press the handles up and slightly forward to full extension.
The converging path feels natural on the shoulders.
Lower with control. A strongman-style overhead press.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An intermediate machine press-pattern exercise targeting the front delts. Viking Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
